name: Evaluate the logic and validity of claims
description: Users asked the AI to evaluate the logical validity of specific claims, arguments, scenarios, or analogies, frequently requesting the identification of fallacies, inconsistencies, or factual inaccuracies. Many requests involved comparing alternative explanations to determine plausibility or correcting flawed reasoning in statements regarding science, history, and philosophy.
